newsitem.title: USA: GATX Q1 boosted by GATX Capital.
newsitem.headline: GATX Q1 boosted by GATX Capital.

text.p: GATX Corp attributed its strong first-quarter earnings to GATX Capital and General American Transportation, but said its GATX Terminals Corp posted a loss of $1.4 million compared to a year-ago profit of $4.7 million.

Continuing weakness in the domestic and international petroleum markets hurt the bulk liquid storage and pipeline subsidiary, GATX said. Throughput was 165 million barrels for the first quarter compared to 168 million barrels a year ago.
GATX Corp's first-quarter net income rose to $31.2 million or $1.35 per share from $24.7 million or $1.05 per share a year ago. Gross income increased to $394.6 million from $303.6 million.
